Package com.here.platform.location.core.mapmatching.model

Class CandidatePath<V>

java.lang.Object
com.here.platform.location.core.mapmatching.model.CandidatePath<V>
Type Parameters:
V - Vertex (road element) type
public final class CandidatePath<V> extends Object

This is an experimental API. It may be removed or changed from one version to the next.

One link in a matched path.

Each instance stores a candidate for one observation and the best path of matches leading to it. Follow predecessor to walk back through earlier observations; reverse the collected nodes to get the path in observation order. The first node has no predecessor or transition.

param: candidate The match candidate for this observation. param: cost The normalized accumulated cost of the best path ending at candidate, with the best candidate at each observation having cost 0. Compare costs only for paths ending at the same observation. param: transition The transition from predecessor.candidate to candidate, or null if predecessor is null. param: predecessor The path ending at a candidate for the previous observation, or null if this is the first observation.
